item.title: [6.8] Heave-Ho: Decentralized Long-Horizon Multi-Humanoid Collaboration
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Collaboration promises to extend humanoid capabilities beyond what individual robots can achieve. However, realizing this potential requires coordinated whole-body interactions, coherent long-horizon planning, and precise synchronization across robots. We introduce Heave-Ho, a decentralized framework for long-horizon collaborative multi-humanoid loco-manipulation.

WHY IT MATTERS

It presents a concrete, decentralized framework for multi-humanoid collaboration combining low-level control and high-level vision-language planning, addressing a key scalability bottleneck in robotics.

item.title: [6.5] MillBill: A Machining Agent with Geometric Feedback
item.description:

Turning a CAD model into a machining program requires both process knowledge and geometric precision. Language models can generate such workflows by writing geometry and toolpath code for each part, but this makes numerical execution part of the model's task. We introduce MillBill, an agent that separates machining decisions from their geometric execution and verification.
